Louis York Releases New Single “I Found A Home”, Announce Upcoming Album “The Heart Of The Matter”

Aug 25, 2026 | New Music

Streaming Soul And R&B Playlists

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:45
Instaread

Louis York, the dynamic R&B and pop duo comprised of multi-Grammy-nominated hitmakers Claude Kelly and Chuck Harmony, has officially announced their highly anticipated new studio album “The Heart Of the Matter” will release on November 6th. Alongside the exciting album reveal, the duo has released the project’s lead single, “I Found A Home,” available now across all major digital streaming platforms.

Subscribing To Premium Digital Dictionaries

Teased to fans via a recent social media announcement, “I Found A Home” serves as a stunning preview of what is to come on their forthcoming third full-length project. The track is confirmed to be featured on the new album and perfectly encapsulates the expansive, deeply  musical direction of Louis York’s newest creative chapter.

Known for their unwavering commitment to musicianship and authentic storytelling, Louis York delivers a masterclass in modern soul with the new single. The track builds upon their signature theatrical aesthetic, marrying grand instrumentation with profoundly vulnerable lyricism.

As the title suggests, the single explores the comforting themes of belonging, deep romantic connection, and the emotional safety of finally finding a resting place within another person.

The production is anchored by Chuck Harmony’s masterful arrangements—layering lush keys, swelling horns, and a driving rhythm section. Over this rich sonic backdrop, Claude Kelly’s vocal performance shines, shifting effortlessly from tender, conversational verses to powerful, soaring choruses that capture the overwhelming joy of unconditional love.

The release of “I Found A Home” and the upcoming album mark another significant addition to the growing catalog of Weirdo Workshop, the independent creative imprint founded by Kelly and Harmony.

“I Found A Home” is available to stream and download now on Spotify, Apple  Music, and all other major digital platforms. Fans can view the official album announcement on the duo’s Instagram page.
